name: agglomeration
description: urban core plus surrounding built‑up areas

name: biased information solution
description: a measure that reduces the loss of decisions based on biased information, ranked here by its share of the avoided loss

name: black-box AI solution
description: a measure that reduces the loss of decisions based on black-box AI, ranked here by its share of the avoided loss

name: canton
description: a member state of the Swiss federation

name: city
description: a large permanent human settlement

name: climate solution
description: A mitigation option that reduces global greenhouse gas emissions, ranked here by effort return score.

name: company
description: legal entity made up of an association of people for the purpose of carrying on a commercial or industrial enterprise

name: conjecture
description: an opinion or a number formed without a direct observation

name: convention
description: a rule fixed by agreement, law or definition instead of a measurement

name: country
description: a distinct part of the world, such as a state, nation, or other political entity.

name: country code
description: the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of a country, used as the prefix of its postal codes

name: currency
description: A currency is a system of money in common use within a specific environment over time, especially for people in a nation state. It is typically issued and controlled by a central bank or monetary authority and serves as a medium of exchange, unit of account, and store of value.

name: EAN
description: European Article Number: the 13 digit barcode number of a retail product, today named International Article Number (IAN)

name: global problem
description: here more a personal issue (wikipedia does not really match)

name: greenhouse gas
description: a gas that absorbs and emits infrared radiation, trapping heat in the atmosphere and warming the surface.

name: ISBN
description: International Standard Book Number: identifies one edition of a book; since 2007 it has 13 digits and equals the EAN of the book with the prefix 978 or 979

name: ISIN
description: International Securities Identification Number (ISO 6166): identifies one security with 12 characters, the country code, the nine character national number and a check digit

name: ISO 4217 code
description: ISO 4217 is the international standard published by the International Organization for Standardization that defines three-letter alphabetic and three-digit numeric codes for the representation of currencies. For example, USD identifies the United States dollar and EUR identifies the euro.

name: mathematical constant
description: A mathematical constant that never changes e.g. Pi

name: most relevant
description: The superlative form of relevance, used to identify the items deemed most important within a given set according to chosen criteria.

name: natural science
description: Natural science is understanding and prediction of natural phenomena, based on empirical evidence

name: Physical constant
description: A physical constant is a physical quantity that is generally believed to be both universal in nature and have constant value in time

name: populism solution
description: a measure that reduces the GDP decline of populism, ranked here by its share of the avoided loss

name: postal code
description: the number of a post office area that is part of a postal address; the number is qualified as postal code, e.g. 1950 (postal code), because the same number can also be a year, and each postal code is the triple of the qualified number in its country, named with the country code as prefix, e.g. CH-1950

name: poverty solution
description: a measure that reduces the loss of poverty, ranked here by its share of the avoided loss

name: region
description: an area of land larger than a city and its surroundings

name: report
description: an account of an observation given by an interested or a single party

name: scaling
description: the multiplication of a quantity by a constant factor

name: science
description: Science organizes knowledge in the form of testable explanations and predictions about the universe

name: SI base unit
description: The SI base units are the standard units of measurement defined by the International System of Units (SI) for the seven base quantities of what is now known as the International System of Quantities: they are notably a basic set from which all other SI units can be derived.

name: solution
description: a homogeneous mixture of a solute dissolved in a solvent

name: Symbol or abbreviation
description: A symbol or abbreviation used to represent a currency in writing, such as $ for the US dollar, € for the euro, or £ for pound sterling. Currency symbols are typographic shorthand and are not standardised internationally (unlike ISO 4217 codes).

name: system
description: A system is a group of interacting or interrelated elements that act according to a set of rules to form a unified whole.

name: warm
description: having or giving off heat

name: wealth concentration solution
description: a measure that reduces the loss of wealth concentration, ranked here by its share of the avoided loss

name: year
description: A year is the time taken for astronomical objects to complete one orbit. For example, a year on Earth is the time taken for Earth to revolve around the Sun.
